Case_25005/figure2.jpg.source_caption: Right wrist histopathology with GMS (Grocott’s methanamine silver) stain

description.short_caption: Histopathology of right wrist tissue with GMS stain showing fungal elements.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image, stained with Grocott’s methenamine silver (GMS), highlights fungal elements as darkly stained structures against a green background. The fungal elements appear as branching hyphae, consistent with a fungal infection. The tissue architecture shows areas of inflammation and possible necrosis. The staining technique is specific for fungal organisms, aiding in their identification.
visible_findings: green background typical of GMS stain

Case_25005/figure1.jpg.source_caption: Right wrist histopathology with PAS (Periodic Acid-Schiff) stain, 400x

description.short_caption: Histopathology of right wrist tissue with PAS stain, 400x magnification.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows tissue from the right wrist stained with PAS (Periodic Acid-Schiff) stain at 400x magnification. The stain highlights fungal elements, which appear as purple, branching, and septate structures within the tissue. The surrounding tissue demonstrates inflammatory changes with cellular infiltration. The PAS stain is used to identify polysaccharides in fungal cell walls, aiding in the diagnosis of fungal infections.

Case_25005/figure6.jpg.source_caption: Findings in the right upper extremity at 4 months after diagnosis

description.short_caption: Right forearm with a healing lesion and surrounding skin changes.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the right forearm of a patient. A prominent, raised lesion with a central crust or scab is visible, surrounded by erythema and mild skin discoloration. The surrounding skin appears thin and atrophic, with some areas of hyperpigmentation. The lesion appears to be in a healing phase, possibly related to a prior infectious or inflammatory process.

Case_25005/figure5.jpg.source_caption: A summary of the treatment course

description.short_caption: Timeline of antifungal treatments and fungal culture results over time.
description.detailed_description: This is a timeline chart showing the duration of various antifungal treatments and the timing of positive fungal culture results from a bone specimen. The x-axis represents days after diagnosis, while the y-axis lists the antifungal agents (Posaconazole, Olorofim, Micafungin, Voriconazole) and the culture results. Colored bars indicate the duration of each treatment: Posaconazole (orange), Olorofim (purple, ongoing), Micafungin (red), and Voriconazole (green). Blue bars represent periods when the bone specimen culture was positive for fungal growth. The chart suggests a prolonged treatment course with overlapping therapies and persistent fungal culture positivity early in the timeline.
visible_findings: Timeline of antifungal treatments (Posaconazole, Olorofim, Micafungin, Voriconazole).
Ongoing treatment with Olorofim (purple bar extending beyond 175 days).
Bone specimen positive fungal culture indicated by blue bars.

Case_25005/figure3.jpg.source_caption: MRI of the right wrist (T1-weighted) at 1 month after diagnosis

description.short_caption: T1-weighted MRI of the right wrist showing abnormal findings.
description.detailed_description: This T1-weighted MRI of the right wrist shows the carpal bones and surrounding soft tissues. There is evidence of abnormal signal intensity in the carpal region, suggestive of possible osteomyelitis or septic arthritis. The image demonstrates soft tissue swelling and potential bone involvement, with areas of hypointensity in the carpal bones. The alignment of the wrist appears preserved.
visible_findings: abnormal signal intensity in carpal bones
hypointense areas in bone suggestive of pathology

Case_25005/figure4.jpg.source_caption: Findings in the right upper extremity at 2 months after diagnosis

description.short_caption: Healing wound with sutures and dressing on the right upper extremity.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a close-up view of the right upper extremity, focusing on a healing wound. The wound is partially covered by a gauze dressing, with sutures visible at the site. Surrounding skin appears erythematous, with some areas of discoloration and mild swelling. The wound edges appear to be approximated, suggesting post-surgical or post-traumatic repair. The background includes indistinct objects, but the focus remains on the wound.
visible_findings: gauze dressing partially covering the wound
